Name: No More Missables
Author: Bennoloth
Description:
Do you hate making choices? Do the consequences of your actions seem like a drag? Or maybe you just like to take things very slow?

This mod adds (almost) anything you can miss in Stardew Valley back in, at the Casino.

[b][u][size=5]What It Adds[/size][/u][/b]

[b]Sam's Event[/b] - one of two missable events in Stardew. Normally requires 3 Hearts with Sam by Fall Year 1. Now, you can see a very slightly modified version of the event (changed a couple words to make sense with Kent's presence) in Year 2 onward.

[b]Clint's Event[/b] - Clint's 6-Heart Event is missable if you get 8 Hearts with Emily before seeing it. It's a bit weird to see after triggering her event, so I didn't make it completely unmissable. However, it is not time-sensitive, so anyone who likes Clint can just friend him before Emily at their own pace. What I did with this event was remove the requirement for his 3-Heart Event to trigger on only Mondays. The 6-Heart Event requires the 3-Heart one, and I found the 3-Heart's Monday requirement to be the biggest obstacle to reasonably see the 6-Heart Event.

[b]Beach Painting[/b] - "Boat" normally only fishable on the Beach farm, now a Casino item.

[b]Hero Trophy/Soda Machine[/b] - Purchase the opposite reward from the Casino after completing the Community Center/Joja Bundles.

[b]Penny 14-Heart Items [/b]- After seeing Penny's 14-Heart event, all of the items unique to this event appear in the Casino, regardless of your choice during the event.

[b]Legendary Fish (Iridium Quality) [/b]- After catching a specific fish, it will appear in the Casino, for 10x its sale price, making these slightly better than Fireworks to convert casino coins into money.

[b]Museum Rewards [/b]- The two Paintings, Standing Geode, Singing Stone, Obsidian Vase, Skeleton Statue, Chicken Statue, and Bear Statue become available at the Casino after completing the Museum.

[b]Birdie Items[/b] - War Memento, Gourmet Tomato Salt, Stardew Valley Rose, Advanced TV Remote, Arctic Shard, Wriggling Worm, and Pirate's Locket are available at the Casino after completing the quest. They don't do anything, but you may wish to decorate with them.

[b]Prismatic Jelly[/b] - After completing the associated quest. Decoration.
[b]
Ectoplasm[/b] - After completing the associated quest. Decoration.

[b][u][size=5]What It Doesn't Add[/size][/u][/b]

[b]Other Museum Rewards[/b] - The Sloth Skeleton seems different to me in the sense that it was created from specific bones you donated - so I don't plan to add that unless someone disagrees. Every other museum reward can be obtained in another way, so they are not missable.

[b]Berry Basket/Lost Axe[/b] - These quest rewards don't seem particularly decorative or useful. Additionally, the quest reward is a small amount of gold and nothing crazy, so if you really wanted to keep it you could just do it. Again, if any demand I will add them in.

[b]Leah's Statue and Painting[/b] - I don't think anyone would want more than 1 of these, they were sentimentally created by Leah and you don't have to choose between a few options, everyone can get them.

[b]Sam's Boombox[/b] - Similar theory to Leah. If requested, I will reconsider.

+
